summary: community.docker now depends on community.library_inventory_filtering_v1 for inventory filtering. Installs via the Ansible package or ansible-galaxy get it automatically, while manual installs must add it.
questions: Why does the docker inventory plugin need another collection?
Does ansible-galaxy install community.docker dependencies automatically?

answer_card.title: community.docker inventory filtering dependency
answer_card.answer_md: community.docker inventory plugins need `community.library_inventory_filtering_v1`. It's included in the Ansible package and installed automatically by `ansible-galaxy`. For manual or git-clone installs, install it yourself.
